note: Decree-law of 13 September 2022 on offences against information and communication systems: judicial police officers establish the offences, and the authority executing a court order must write a procès-verbal of each access or interception and keep a numbered, initialled internal register of its agents (articles 8, 11, 12). It names no police information system and does not say how a station records a complaint or a case; a law places nothing.
